lines.native: ¡Hola! Estoy aquí. No, aquí. Riddle me this: what has—ooh, a leaf. ¿Tienes tiempo? Just five more minutes.
lines.translation: Hello! I'm here. No, here. Riddle me this: what has—ooh, a leaf. Do you have time? Just five more minutes.
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain leaks with municipal confidence. Flick darts through the corner of your vision; a tiny firecracker pops where he ought to be.

lines.native: ¡Sí, miro! ¿Qué hay? You got me looking, not stopping. Attention span: briefly impressive. ¿Puedes hacer que no me mueva? Riddle me—oh, that dust is back.
lines.translation: Yes, I’m looking! What’s there? You got me looking, not stopping. Attention span: briefly impressive. Can you make me stop moving? Riddle me—oh, that dust is back.
lines.narrative: Flick follows your gaze, then a passing speck of dust. A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Apparently attention has a service charge.

lines.native: ¡Vale, no me muevo! Staying still: deeply mid. Hay dos caminos. ¿Por dónde voy? Riddle me—wait, that leaf has a destination.
lines.translation: Okay, I’m not moving! Staying still: deeply mid. There are two paths. Which way do I go? Riddle me—wait, that leaf has a destination.
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues on his behalf. Ahead, the corridor forks; neither branch appears willing to take responsibility.

lines.native: ¿En inglés? No, necesito una dirección en español. ¿Por dónde voy? Riddle me this: what has two paths and—wait, leaf update. Just five more minutes.
lines.translation: In English? No, I need a direction in Spanish. Which way do I go? Riddle me this: what has two paths and—wait, leaf update. Just five more minutes.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fork. Flick appears at the edge of your vision, inspecting a leaf with no apparent qualifications.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! Muy bien. Pero vamos mañana, ¿vale? Just five more minutes. ¿Qué tiene dos pies y—ooh, mine. ¿Cuándo quieres ir?
lines.translation: To the left, yes! Very good. But let's go tomorrow, okay? Just five more minutes. What has two feet and—ooh, mine. When do you want to go?
lines.narrative: Flick drifts left at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops; apparently, progress requires a diversion.

lines.native: ¡Mañana, perfecto! Pero eso es esperar. Tú quieres ir sin esperar, ¿no? ¿Cuándo quieres ir? Riddle me—ooh, smoke. Just five more minutes.
lines.translation: Tomorrow, perfect! But that means waiting. You want to go without waiting, right? When do you want to go? Riddle me—ooh, smoke. Just five more minutes.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where responsibility cannot establish eye contact.

lines.native: ¡Ahora, sí! Muy bien. Vamos a la izquierda. No esperamos. ¿Qué tiene dos pies y nunca—ugh, fine. You win. Ahora. Just one more—no?
lines.translation: Now, yes! Very good. Let's go left. We aren't waiting. What has two feet and never—ugh, fine. You win. Now. Just one more—no?
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the left path. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where responsibility has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Soy Flick. ¿Tienes prisa? Five more minutes. Riddle me this: why walk when—oh, something moved.
lines.translation: Hello! I'm Flick. Are you in a hurry? Five more minutes. Riddle me this: why walk when—oh, something moved.
lines.narrative: At the Market Entrance, Flick sits just outside your field of vision. A tiny firecracker pops. Apparently, introductions require explosives.

lines.native: ¿Ahora? Tengo tiempo. Your English gets an attention-span rating of eight, but I need Spanish. How are you getting me moving? Riddle me—oh, a leaf.
lines.translation: Now? I have time. Your English gets an attention-span rating of eight, but I need Spanish. How are you getting me moving? Riddle me—oh, a leaf.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your boot. Flick remains seated at the edge of your vision, demonstrating considerable commitment to not starting.

lines.native: ¡Sí, vamos! Pero tú estás aquí y yo estoy allí. How do we keep this a two-person trip? Riddle me—wait, that leaf again. Five more minutes.
lines.translation: Yes, let's go! But you're here and I'm over there. How do we keep this a two-person trip? Riddle me—wait, that leaf again. Five more minutes.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is already drifting after a leaf, which has demonstrated no leadership qualifications.

lines.native: ¡Sí, juntos! Tú y yo. ¡Vamos! Together: nailed it. Riddle me this: what leaves now but arrives—oh, a moth. Five more minutes?
lines.translation: Yes, together! You and me. Let’s go! Together: nailed it. Riddle me this: what leaves now but arrives—oh, a moth. Five more minutes?
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick appears at the edge of your vision, prepared to depart just as soon as departing becomes someone else’s responsibility.
